---
type: memory
title: Adding & Subtracting Fractions
---

Flip two cards at a time. Match each **sum or difference** to its **combined fraction**.

| Expression | Combined |
|:-----------|:---------|
| $\frac{a}{x} + \frac{b}{x}$ | $\frac{a + b}{x}$ |
| $\frac{a}{b} + \frac{c}{d}$ | $\frac{ad + bc}{bd}$ |
| $\frac{a}{b} - \frac{c}{d}$ | $\frac{ad - bc}{bd}$ |
| $\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}$ | $\frac{y + x}{xy}$ |
| $\frac{2}{x} + \frac{3}{x^2}$ | $\frac{2x + 3}{x^2}$ |

## Hint
You can only add tops when the bottoms match. If they already match (same $x$), just add the tops.

## Hint
If the bottoms don't match, cross multiply: each top gets multiplied by the **other** fraction's bottom, and the new bottom is the two bottoms multiplied.
Careful with $\frac{2}{x} + \frac{3}{x^2}$: $x^2$ is already a multiple of $x$, so the common bottom is just $x^2$.

## Solution
Cross multiplying multiplies each fraction by a form of $1$, so nothing changes in value:
$$
\begin{aligned}
    \frac{a}{b} + \frac{c}{d} &= \frac{a}{b} \cdot \frac{d}{d} + \frac{c}{d} \cdot \frac{b}{b} \\
                              &= \frac{ad}{bd} + \frac{bc}{bd} \\
                              &= \frac{ad + bc}{bd}
\end{aligned}
$$
